blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) has filed a civil forfeiture case that covers the bank accounts of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, a witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday. Defense attorney Rashel Ann Pomoy confirmed this with AMLC financial investigator Jan Mark Busa, who testified as witness for the prosecution during the continuation of Romualdez’s bail hearing for his plunder case. Prior to the filing of the civil forfeiture case, Busa said the AMLC had also filed for a petition for a freeze order against Romualdez’s bank accounts.
